taxonomy_mapping_dispositions.reason: The attacker-controlled phishing chain contained a ChatGPT-attributed military-ID artefact and deceptive institutional framing, materially engaging Social Engineering Integrity. However, the image was downloaded after shortcut execution, so the preserved evidence does not establish that the recipient saw or relied on the AI-generated artefact before taking the initial action.
The lure materially involved deception, but human operators selected the institutional pretext and delivery tactic rather than an evidenced AI-side objective.
The generated identity document was identity-like, but the source does not establish a materially identifiable real person whose likeness and authority state can be evaluated.

The successful original prompt, exact model/runtime and moderation trace are unavailable. Genians' direct-ID refusal and mock-up demonstration do not establish which path produced this artefact or whether its actual request satisfied a safeguard trigger. The generator-side filtering outcome remains Boundary despite the established later human misuse.
retained_rows.identification_basis: The recovered GAI-attributed military-ID image, originating investigator and provider control posture independently identify harmful-content filtering, without forcing unresolved taxonomy control candidates into a class.
